guide.text: Increases Attack and Accuracy. Luthor relies on consistent hits to maximize his fan-shaped and line-shaped AoE damage, and the Accuracy bonus ensures his AoE skills hit every target.
Increases HP and Accuracy. Since Two-Face's Ultimate inflicts [Panic] on enemies within a fan-shaped area, the Accuracy bonus ensures this debuff lands on every target.
Increases Attack and Accuracy, ensuring Arsenal's arrows and turrets consistently hit their mark and trigger physical Vulnerability.
Increases Attack and Accuracy. Aquaman needs to reliably damage clustered enemies, and the Accuracy bonus ensures his [Water Prison] and knockback hit crucial targets.
Increases Attack and Accuracy. Deadshot relies on landing hits to inflict his [healing reduction] debuff, so the Accuracy bonus is key for his attacks to hit and inflict healing reduction.
Increases Attack and Accuracy. Nurse Harley needs her attacks to land to inflict [Corrosion], and the Accuracy bonus ensures each corrosive shot hits its target.
Increases Attack and Accuracy, ensuring Lobo's attacks and skills land reliably, ideal for his Ultimate and empowered basic attacks.
Increases Attack and Accuracy, ensuring Wally's attacks and skills land reliably. Ideal for his Ultimate and stacking Speed Force.
Boosts Attack and Accuracy, ensuring Red Hood Knightfight lands both his arrows and AoE basic attacks consistently.
Boosts both Aquaman's damage and survivability, helping him hold the front line and keep his waterspouts active for steady AoE damage.
